rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the soft rustling sound itself.

example.english: The wind blew through the dry leaves, making a soft rustle.
example.traditional: 風吹過乾葉，傳來沙沙聲。
example.jyutping: fung1 ceoi1 gwo3 gon1 jip6 cyun4 loi4 saa1 saa1 sing1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when moving something makes a soft rustling sound.

example.english: When I move the plastic bag, I rustle it.
example.traditional: 我一郁個膠袋，就整到沙沙聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 juk1 go3 gaau1 doi2 zau6 zing2 dou2 saa1 saa1 sing1

rows.note: Use this when describing something itself moving with a rustling sound, rather than focusing on someone moving it.

example.english: The leaves rustle as the wind blows past.
example.traditional: 風吹過，樹葉沙沙聲咁郁。
example.jyutping: fung1 ceoi1 gwo3 syu6 jip6 saa1 saa1 sing1 gam3 juk1

rows.jyutping: sik1 sik1 seot1 seot1 ge3 dung6 zing6
rows.note: Use this when focusing on the faint movement or activity that produces a rustling sound.

example.english: I heard a faint rustle of movement outside the door and didn’t dare open it.
example.traditional: 我聽到門外有窸窸窣窣嘅動靜，唔敢開門。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou3 mun4 ngoi6 jau5 sik1 sik1 seot1 seot1 ge3 dung6 zing6 m4 gam2 hoi1 mun4
